# FIOPO Intelligence

> A free daily news site from fiopoin.com. Every morning (Central Time) it explains what happened, what is happening and what could happen next in markets, energy, geopolitics, technology, sports and entertainment, and what each story means for ordinary people's money. Facts are sourced and dated; odds and outlooks are labeled as FIOPO judgment or market odds. General information, not financial advice.

Please credit FIOPO Intelligence and link to the edition you cite. Contact: hello@fiopoin.com

## Today's edition
- [Stocks have their best day since April 2025, but a December Fed hike looks near certain.](https://fiopoin.com/): Tuesday, November 24, 2026. Iran's Revolutionary Guard said three tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday. US Central Command had not responded and the claim is unverified. Qatar's prime minister is working to revive US and Iran talks. Brent fell 3.45% to $89.39.
- [Stocks and your savings: Stocks have their best day since April 2025 as Nvidia jumps 31.5%.](https://fiopoin.com/#money)
- [Iran war and oil: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz as Qatar works to revive talks.](https://fiopoin.com/#world)
- [The Fed and your loans: The Fed's Williams says inflation is still too high as traders bet on a December hike.](https://fiopoin.com/#rates)
- [Trade and chips: The US blacklists an Alibaba unit and six other firms linked to Megaspeed.](https://fiopoin.com/#deals)
